title: RCMP probes Cranbrook custody death
article: The RCMP are investigating the death of a 30- year-old Cranbrook man who died in police custody on New Years Eve.
Mounties found Ryan Snopek passed out on the steps of a house on Dec. 31.
Police were told by the victim's friends that he had been creating a disturbance in the house so they took him outside.
Snopek was examined by emergency crews and then arrested for assault, mischief and being drunk in a public place.
While Snopek was in custody, a guard noticed he was having difficulty breathing and alerted the police members on duty.
The man was rushed to hospital in Cranbrook but died.
Police said Monday they were waiting for the results of an autopsy to determine the cause of death.
